brief: pillar: relief, funnel: reach. HUB_AUG_BRIEF02_SWITCH VAR01. Photographed London bus-stop 6-sheet, shot slightly off-square, pavement and traffic visible. Hand-drawn marker caps, black on white. Hububb app icon (silver isometric H on a dark rounded square) sits top right in the copy, like a product pack shot — not a phone. Caps stay because they are this template's identity. Generated as a real street photograph, not a flat mockup.
